reviews.text: The wash dawg is the best!! I’m so happy to be able to bring Frankie here again! Chaz is amazing at her work and brenda the shop owner is an amazing person she’s so pretty and such a boss (literally and metaphorically speaking) I love this place if you need to bring your dog for a haircut look no further I also love how they do by appointment only they don’t have dogs sitting in crates for hours waiting on their appointments all day I don’t bring Frankie in at 8am just to have his hair cut at 3pm no if Frankie goes in at 11 Frankie gets his hair cut at 11! And he’s done in an hour I’ll make the 25 min drive to just come here for his haircut
We visit the wash dawg all the time.  Always a great experience.

My first time using a groomer for our dog.  Blake on phone was very informative and comforting. Price was on point with other groomers. No frills and fast. Thank you. 4 verses 5 due to no cute bandana or bow as in the outline of service. Minor thing.
My two go-to brick & mortar dog grooming salons is this place along with Pet Bath & Beyond.
The Wash Dawg always takes great care with our dogs. They come back clean and well groomed and, missing from other groomers, not stressed out. Highly recommend for their service and cost.

I had an appointment at 2:15 today that I was 15 minutes late for and they cancelled me. I was standing in their shop at 2:31pm and said I'd need to reschedule. 2 dogs twice a year and I never balked on their expensive prices. Never again will I return. I love to speak with the OWNER

I’ve been a loyal customer of The Wash Dawg for years, and I can confidently say that this place is the best pet grooming salon around! Every single visit has been a wonderful experience, and I truly trust the team with my pet’s care. The staff is always warm, welcoming, and incredibly skilled, making me feel at ease knowing that my furry friends are in great hands.
It’s clear they are passionate about animals, and the love and attention they give are unmatched. The salon itself is always clean, organized, and a calming environment for pets.
I’m truly grateful for The Wash Dawg and their consistent high-quality service over the years. If you want a grooming experience that’s stress-free, professional, and tailored to your pet, this is the place to go!
Always happy to bring my dog here, they are very quick. My German shepherd had a grooming plus teeth and nails within 50 minutes on a Saturday!
I have been taking my maltase to Chaz !! We love her ! She does a fantastic job !! Lovie always looks amazing! I love the staff !!
They are always professional, on time and quick.
Our girls have always done well coming here even though I know they can be a handful. Remi is fully deaf and Frankie is a very anxious girl but they care for them so well. Highly recommend.

I would love to give a employee named lala all the respect and credit for being so friendly with our baby boy and always having him groomed down looking sharp and smelling like so fresh sugar cookies if your looking for a gentle kind great dog groomer lala is the person to go to !!!

5/5 in groomer 5/5 in customer service  5/5 in overall vibe would recommend to anyone who loves there fur babies!!!
Most efficient groomer in town. These guys get you dog in and out in a professional manner. Love it.
